title: CANN RIVER VIC - Upgrade the Network

updates.content:
Completed: Planned network upgrade in Cann River, VIC.

An upstream provider has finished scheduled works to improve network infrastructure in your area. The maintenance window ran from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on 21 July 2026, and some services may have experienced a brief interruption of up to 60 minutes.

All services are now expected to be online. If your connection is still affected, please restart your modem/router. If issues continue, contact our support team and we’ll help get you back online.
